summary: Public projects created on 1 May 2026: 3 repos.
intro: Three agent plugins and a documentation concept covered agent tooling: a wiki built for AI readers, an Android media importer for moving files off a phone, and a PII scanner for credentials and personal data across files and repositories.

projects.name: Agent Wiki Idea
projects.description: Exploring what a wiki looks like when its primary readers are AI agents — vector-native, tool-driven, no pages.

projects.name: Android Media Importer
projects.description: Claude Code plugin: move or copy media from a connected Android phone using user-defined mappings, MIME-based routing, optional date-folder + orientation-split layouts.

projects.name: Claude PII Scanner Plugin
projects.description: PII scanner: credentials, generic PII, and personal-inventory matches across files, directories, and git repos.
